newsitem.title: USA: First USA to exchange capital securities.
newsitem.headline: First USA to exchange capital securities.

text.p: First USA Inc said Wednesday it will exchange up to $200 million of its First USA Capital Trust I unit's 9.33 percent Series B Capital Securities for a like amount of the 9.33 percent Series A Capital Securities issued in December 1996.

First USA said it is offering to exchange its guarantee of certain payments from the Series A securities for a like guarantee from the Series B securities. It said it is also offering an exchange $200 million of its 9.33 percent Series B Junior Subordinated Deferrable Interest Debentures due Jan. 15, 2027, for a like principal amount of 9.33 percent Series A Junior Subordinated Deferrable Interest Debentures.
First USA said the offer will expire at 0900 EDT/1300 GMT on June 19, 1997.
